sprint: Letter/Number Shapes -- closing the literal reading of 'alphabets, numbers should also be part of shapes'
task: Direct follow-up to the just-shipped Marker font + Shape-Mosaic Fill Style feature. After investigating whether 'alphabets, numbers should also be part of shapes' had been left incomplete, told explicitly to only confirm and not implement -- I presented two interpretations, and the user gave the decisive, binding instruction: 'your second interpretation is correct. the literal one.' This confirms individual standalone Letter (A-Z) and Number (0-9) entries as real, pickable SHAPE_KINDS catalog items -- analogous to the existing Circle/Star/Rectangle/etc. shapes -- in both rendering engines. Added 36 new entries (letter-A..letter-Z, number-0..number-9) to js/stickerLibrary.js's SHAPE_KINDS (root Studio) and tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/experienceSchema.js's SHAPE_KINDS (World Builder v2), each with a plain label ('Letter X'/'Number N') and the bare character as its icon. renderer/slideRenderer.js gained a new _shapeLetterChar(kind)/_drawLetterShape(ctx,ch,rect,cx,cy,d) pair using canvas fillText/strokeText with auto-fit sizing (matches the existing 15-geometry _layerDrawShape dispatch, dispatched before it and reusing the same rotation/fill/stroke pipeline every other shape already has); tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/engineRuntime.js's _drawShape gained the mirrored _shapeLetterChar/_drawLetterShape pair, kept in lockstep by hand per this codebase's established two-rendering-engines discipline. builder.js's convergeSceneLayer needed zero changes -- its existing decoration-shape compile branch already spreads layer.shape/fillColor/rotation/etc. through unfiltered for any string value. Zero changes needed to any picker/control UI, since every Shape-authoring surface already iterates SHAPE_KINDS generically with no per-value special-casing. Verified via a new 5-part, 24-assertion Playwright suite (both catalogs' entry counts/labels/icons; World Builder's engine rendering including rotation and auto-fit sizing for a wide/short rect; the compile step carrying shape/fillColor/rotation through unchanged; root Studio's real Reader-facing renderer honoring both the compiled shape and a live rotation override, confirming Publish Fidelity/Creator Governing Rule #5) -- 24/24 passed on the first run, zero implementation or test-authoring bugs found. Full regression: both goldenBuild.js suites pass unchanged; every directly-relevant existing Shape/Rotation/Fill Playwright suite (verify_font_shapefill.js 37/0, verify_image_rotation.js, verify_text_rotation.js 22/0, verify_text_rotation_pivot.js 5/0, verify_text_align_fidelity_fix.js, manageframes_inline_rotation_verify2.js 16/0, museum_regression.js) passed unchanged; museum_realfile_pixelhash.js (the real, on-disk Museum Gallery .vtheme rendered end to end) produced the exact, historically-recorded SHA-256 hash e7b2a905613dbef3d2f9064211103d84762d7039d3bee404df90f4d90899b390, confirming zero regression for a theme not using the new shape kinds. Two apparent anomalies during regression (place_resize_shape_verify.js's Test B, verify_shapes.js/2/3's Mandatory-Sign-In-gate timeouts) were confirmed via git-stash A/B testing to be pre-existing test-infra flakiness/staleness, not real regressions caused by this change. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to js/stickerLibrary.js, renderer/slideRenderer.js, tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/{experienceSchema,engineRuntime}.js. A separate, unprompted user aside -- 'we can retire v1' (tools/world-builder/, the older World Builder tool) -- was deliberately NOT acted upon; it remains a separate, larger, not-yet-scoped decision awaiting its own explicit discussion.
